title: Panda Bubble Pop
description: Aim with an adorable kung-fu panda to bank colorful bubbles off bamboo walls, pop clusters of three or more, and free trapped baby cubs.
controls: Drag to aim the dotted trajectory and release to shoot bubbles into matching clusters.

zh-CN.title: 熊猫泡泡龙
zh-CN.description: 萌系经典射击消除熊猫泡泡龙：帮功夫小熊猫精准弹射彩色泡泡，击落整串泡泡救出被困萌娃超有成就感！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动虚线瞄准同色泡泡群，松手发射凑齐三个及以上消除并营救小熊猫。
